purpose: Authoritative, editorially approved criminal-conduct, legal-action, official-finding and response records for person and institution dossiers, including the evidence-classified Predators in Power and Criminal Investigations layers.
publicationRule: Only records with publicationStatus=approved are rendered. Automated matches, anonymous claims and unsourced allegations remain private review candidates and never publish directly.
rules: A conviction label requires an adjudicated criminal outcome from an authoritative source.
Charges, indictments, complaints, arrests and investigations are not proof of guilt.
Civil and regulatory actions must not be described as criminal convictions.
Dismissals, acquittals, reversals, withdrawals, pardons, denials and right-of-reply statements must remain attached to the claim.
Association or proximity is neutral unless reliable evidence establishes knowledge, facilitation, concealment, participation, obstruction or another relevant act.
Anonymous or unsourced allegations must not be published.
Every record requires provenance, date, legal status, evidence grade, counter-evidence, proof needed and a boundary statement.
Every existing criminal or safeguarding dossier represented in this registry must be regenerated and audited on every mission build.

conviction_final_judgment.label: Convictions / Final Criminal Judgments
conviction_final_judgment.boundary: Limited to the exact offense, defendant, court, jurisdiction and disposition stated in the final record.

charge_indictment_complaint.label: Charges / Indictments / Criminal Complaints
charge_indictment_complaint.boundary: A charge, indictment or complaint is an accusation, not proof of guilt. Presumption of innocence applies unless and until adjudicated.

investigation_inquiry.label: Investigations / Inquiries
investigation_inquiry.boundary: An investigation or inquiry records the scope and findings of the named official process. It does not substitute for a criminal conviction and must be read with the report's limitations.

civil_regulatory_action.label: Civil / Regulatory / Sanctions Actions
civil_regulatory_action.boundary: Civil, regulatory, sanctions and administrative actions are distinct from criminal convictions and may be resolved without admissions.

substantiated_allegation.label: Substantiated Public Allegations
substantiated_allegation.boundary: The allegation is attributed and supported by identified evidence or an official report but remains distinct from a criminal conviction unless adjudicated.

suspected_conduct.label: Suspected Conduct / Analytical Hypotheses
suspected_conduct.boundary: This is an evidence-linked analytical hypothesis, not an established fact or legal finding.

rumor_speculation.label: Rumors / Speculation
rumor_speculation.boundary: Not established. Inclusion records the existence and origin of a public claim, not its truth.

exculpatory_disposition.label: Acquittals / Dismissals / Reversals / Responses
exculpatory_disposition.boundary: This record preserves the outcome, denial, response or exculpatory information and must be read with the underlying allegation.

recordTemplate.title: Neutral source-faithful title
recordTemplate.summary: What the source establishes and no more.
